how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-eastern-plaguelands-02.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:6136:obj:0: Find Borelgore in the northern wastes of ⟦E1⟧ and destroy him. Return to ⟦E2⟧ Blightcaller when the mission is complete.
rows.quest:6136:details:0: Past the Argent Dawn encampment of Light's ⟦E3⟧ and west of Northdale, you will find the corpulent maggot beast, Borelgore.
rows.quest:6136:details:1: BI've lost entire regiments to that monster. His size knows no bounds! The more he eats the greater his girth becomes...
rows.quest:6136:details:2: BWhile I would not suffer any emotional harm should the beast devour you, I would prefer that you were the victor. Borelgore has been known to devour others who tried to hunt him.
rows.quest:6136:completion:0: Keep this up and I may have to promote you from imbecile to mental deficient, first class.
rows.quest:6144:obj:0: ⟦E4⟧ to the ⟦E5⟧ and speak with Varimathras.
rows.quest:6144:details:0: The order has come down, ⟦1⟧. Varimathras himself has requested that I send my most 'capable' agents back to the ⟦E5⟧ for a highly sensitive tactical operation.
rows.quest:6144:details:1: BUnfortunately, my most capable agents were killed over three years ago. In their stead I have a collection of brain dead riff-raff.
rows.quest:6144:details:3: BTravel to the ⟦E5⟧ at once and report to Varimathras. Do not embarrass me, ⟦3⟧!
rows.quest:6144:completion:0: The Grand Crusader sits safely in the ⟦E6⟧ Bastion while his forces pour into your lands, desecrate your structures and monuments and murder your people.
rows.quest:6144:completion:1: BThe Dark Lady has commanded that I deal with this insect once and for all. You will become the instrument of the ⟦E7⟧'s reckoning.
rows.quest:6145:obj:0: Return to ⟦E1⟧ and track down the Crimson Courier. Kill the Courier and recover the Grand Crusader's Command.
rows.quest:6145:obj:1: BTake the command to ⟦E2⟧ Blightcaller for further instruction.
rows.quest:6145:details:0: Just as the body cannot survive without the head, the head cannot survive without the body. The defenses of the ⟦E8⟧'s command inside ⟦E9⟧ are almost impenetrable. We must, instead, cut the body out from under the head.
rows.quest:6145:details:1: BMy Deathstalkers have been collecting data on the activity of the Crusade outside of ⟦E9⟧. Each day, a report is sent from their central command to Tyr's Hand. This report is the key, ⟦4⟧! Find the Crimson Courier and recover that report. Return it to ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:6145:completion:1: BExcellent! Finally! An opportunity to destroy the ⟦E6⟧ Oracle!
rows.quest:6146:obj:0: ⟦E4⟧ to Tyr's Hand, southeast of the Marris Stead. Once there, take a bite of the Rotten Apple. While under the guise of the ⟦E8⟧, deliver the Grand Crusader's Command to Crusader Lord Valdelmar.
rows.quest:6146:details:0: I have made some adjustments to this command. Should our little ruse work, they will expose the ⟦E6⟧ Oracle and we shall strike!
rows.quest:6146:details:1: BNow pay attention, ⟦6⟧. You are to deliver this command to the Crusader Lord, Valdelmar.
rows.quest:6146:details:2: BHow? You are going to hand it to him, imbecile.
rows.quest:6146:details:3: BTake the command and this rotten apple to Tyr's Hand. When you cross into the city, eat the apple. You will transform into something more... palatable to the humans. Take the command and hand it to the Crusader Lord, Valdelmar.
rows.quest:6146:completion:0: Where have you been? We had thought the Scourge had captured you.
rows.quest:6147:obj:0: Return to ⟦E2⟧ Blightcaller with the new information.⟦7⟧
rows.quest:6147:details:0: The Grand Crusader makes an unusual request. Hrm, regardless... what he asks will be done. Return to the ⟦E6⟧ Bastion and notify him that the Oracle will be en route shortly.
rows.quest:6147:details:1: BWe will take every precaution to ensure that she makes it to ⟦E9⟧ unharmed.
rows.quest:6147:completion:0: The fools! My deception went unnoticed! Prepare yourself, ⟦8⟧. We must strike with cold cunning!
rows.quest:6148:obj:0: The ⟦E8⟧ is on the move. Somewhere along the road from Tyr's Hand to ⟦E9⟧ you will find the Oracle, Demetria, and her entourage. Hunt her down and slay her. Return to ⟦E2⟧ Blightcaller should you succeed.
rows.quest:6148:details:0: Demetria is chief advisor to the Grand Crusader. She is called the Oracle due to her 'otherworldly' senses. She has successfully assisted the Crusade in several of their victories against the Scourge.
rows.quest:6148:details:1: BWhile this ruse was successful in exposing her, if she truly does possess psychic powers, she will undoubtedly be expecting some sort of trouble. You are going to provide that 'trouble.'
rows.quest:6148:details:2: BTrack down the Oracle and terminate her. They should be moving out of Tyr's Hand as we speak. Make me proud, worm.⟦9⟧
rows.quest:6148:completion:0: They will be reeling from this blow for years! Well done, ⟦10⟧! You have earned not only my respect but also this reward.
rows.quest:6164:obj:0: Bring ⟦E10⟧' Receipt Book to ⟦E10⟧ the Touched in Terrordale.
rows.quest:6164:details:0: I'm ready for business! What you do want?
rows.quest:6164:details:1: BOh wait... I can't open up shop without my receipt book. How am I to keep track of things without my receipt book?
rows.quest:6164:details:2: BI must have left it in town somewhere. I had a room in the inn... the book must be there.
rows.quest:6164:details:3: BBring me my book. Please, bring it to me! Bring me my book and you'll see! I'll set up shop and you'll see that my prices are INSANE!
rows.quest:6164:completion:0: There it is! And oh my! I forgot how full it was!
rows.quest:6164:completion:1: BThis is a glorious day, ⟦11⟧! Stupendous! Insanely good, I say!
rows.quest:6185:obj:0: Scour the ⟦E1⟧ for clues as to the "Blightcaller" and the missing SI:7 agents. If you find any SI:7 Insignias, return them to Flint Shadowmore at Chillwind Camp.
rows.quest:6185:details:0: As I said, your first mission is one of reconnaissance. Nothing fancy, ⟦12⟧. You must travel to the ⟦E1⟧ and look for any clues as to this Blightcaller.
rows.quest:6185:details:1: BBe on the lookout for information about our missing operatives. We have to assume that they are dead and if they are dead, they must have a corpse... somewhere.
rows.quest:6185:details:3: BAll SI:7 agents carry this insignia.
rows.quest:6185:details:4: B<Flint shows you his SI:7 insignia.>
rows.quest:6185:details:5: BBring any of those that you may find back to me.
rows.quest:6185:completion:2: BWhere were they? Did you discover any more information about this bastard, the Blightcaller?
rows.quest:6187:obj:0: Assemble an army and travel to the ⟦E1⟧. Launch a full assault on ⟦E2⟧ Blightcaller and any ⟦E11⟧ filth that may attempt to protect him.
rows.quest:6187:obj:1: BKeep your wits about you, ⟦14⟧. The ⟦E11⟧ will defend the ranger lord with their very lives.
rows.quest:6187:details:0: Do you know how many ranger lords exist in this world? How many human ranger lords have ever existed?
rows.quest:6187:details:1: BNathanos' accomplishments were unprecedented. He was a tactical genius, responsible for ⟦E12⟧ victories spanning a decade of conflict.
rows.quest:6187:details:2: BAnd now... the champion of the ⟦E7⟧.
rows.quest:6187:details:3: BNo. This cannot be. Order must be restored.
rows.quest:6187:details:4: BGather an army, ⟦15⟧. Return to the Plagues with your army and destroy the Blightcaller.
rows.quest:6187:details:5: BI wish you luck, ⟦16⟧. Truly, you will need it for this battle.
rows.quest:6187:completion:0: It is a tragedy. I think... I believe that our kind is cursed, ⟦17⟧. We are cursed to lose our greatest warriors; our most noble heroes; our most gifted scholars.
rows.quest:6187:completion:1: BWe are indebted to you and I assure you, ⟦18⟧, wherever ⟦E2⟧ Marris is now, he smiles down upon you.
rows.quest:8929:obj:0: Use the Extra-Dimensional Ghost Revealer at the entrance to ⟦E9⟧ and speak with the ghost of Anthion Harmon.
rows.quest:8929:details:0: Well, nothing left for us to do but try out the goblin's invention. Word has it that Anthion was mowed down by the undead legions of ⟦E9⟧ as he tried to enter its gates.
rows.quest:8929:details:1: BTry using the device there and find out whatever Anthion knew.
rows.quest:8929:completion:0: Deliana had you contact me? I'll do my best to help you, but first I must ask a great favor of you.
rows.quest:8930:obj:0: Use the Extra-Dimensional Ghost Revealer at the entrance to ⟦E9⟧ and speak with the ghost of Anthion Harmon.
rows.quest:8930:details:0: Very well, ⟦19⟧. All that remains is to put the goblin's invention to the test. Word has it that Anthion was slain by the undead legions of ⟦E9⟧ as he tried to enter its gates.
rows.quest:8930:details:1: BTry using the device there and see if, indeed, you can speak with the dead!
rows.quest:8930:completion:0: Mokvar had you contact me? I'll do my best to help you, but first I must ask a great favor of you.
rows.quest:8946:obj:0: Bring Ysida's Locket to Anthion Harmon in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:8946:details:0: It is the cruelest of fates that my beloved has perished while trying to rescue me. Yet, you claim to possess the ability to converse with him.
rows.quest:8946:details:1: BBring him this locket as proof that I am well. He must not linger in this world; my heart would not be able to bear it.
rows.quest:8946:details:2: BFarewell, ⟦20⟧. I shall be in your debt always.
rows.quest:8946:completion:0: That locket... you found her! I can rest in peace at long last.
rows.quest:8946:completion:1: BI shall now answer any questions you might have, ⟦21⟧. But make haste, my time in this world is not long.
rows.quest:8947:obj:0: Bring 3 Dark Iron Bars, 20 Enchanted Leather, 3 Mooncloth and 4 Cured Rugged Hides to Anthion Harmon in the ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:8947:details:0: We didn't realize the importance of Valthalak's medallion, so it was divided along with the rest of the spoils. The first piece was taken by a dwarf named Theldren. I tried to retrieve it from him and he beat me within an inch of my life. You shall have to take the fragment by force.
rows.quest:8947:details:1: BLast I heard of him, he'd become a gladiator for the Dark Iron dwarves. Getting him to fight you is going to present a bit of a challenge, though.
rows.quest:8947:details:2: BGather the following materials for me. You're going to need them.
rows.quest:8947:completion:0: Excellent. I shall transmute these into something more suitable to our needs.
rows.quest:9121:obj:0: Archmage Angela Dosantos at Light's ⟦E3⟧ Chapel in the ⟦E1⟧ wants 5 ⟦E13⟧ Crystals, 2 Nexus Crystals, 1 Righteous Orb and 60 gold pieces. You must also be Honored with the Argent Dawn.⟦22⟧
rows.quest:9121:details:0: In the thick of Plaguewood lies the entrance to the dread citadel of ⟦E14⟧. Previously, all attempts to enter had been stymied by the magical wards placed upon the rune portal. That is, until now.
rows.quest:9121:details:1: BWe have devised a way to gain entry via arcane cloaking - an old cantrip of the Kirin ⟦E15⟧ with a few modifications of my own. Since your dedication to the cause of the Dawn is somewhat lacking, ⟦23⟧, the price will be high. You may decline and choose to return when you are revered or exalted for a discount.
rows.quest:9121:completion:0: You will feel a slight tingle, ⟦24⟧. That sensation means it's working. Once complete, you will be able to enter ⟦E14⟧ by stepping upon the rune portal in Plaguewood.
rows.quest:9122:obj:0: Archmage Angela Dosantos at Light's ⟦E3⟧ Chapel in the ⟦E1⟧ wants 2 ⟦E13⟧ Crystals, 1 Nexus Crystal and 30 gold pieces. You must also be Revered with the Argent Dawn.
rows.quest:9122:details:0: In the thick of Plaguewood lies the entrance to the dread citadel of ⟦E14⟧. Previously, all attempts to enter had been stymied by the magical wards placed upon the rune portal. That is, until now.
rows.quest:9122:details:1: BWe have devised a way to gain entry via a permanent arcane cloaking of sorts - an old cantrip of the Kirin ⟦E15⟧ with a few modifications of my own. With that said, the cloaking is costly. Since your dedication to the cause of the Dawn is admirable, we are willing to incur some of those costs.
rows.quest:9122:completion:0: You will feel a slight tingle, ⟦25⟧. That sensation means it's working. Once complete, you will be able to enter ⟦E14⟧ by stepping upon the rune portal in Plaguewood.
rows.quest:9123:obj:0: Archmage Angela Dosantos at Light's ⟦E3⟧ Chapel in the ⟦E1⟧ will grant you ⟦E13⟧ Cloaking at no cost. You must be Exalted with the Argent Dawn.
rows.quest:9123:details:0: In the thick of Plaguewood lies the entrance to the dread citadel of ⟦E14⟧. Previously, all attempts to enter had been stymied by the magical wards placed upon the rune portal. That is, until now.
rows.quest:9123:details:1: BWe have devised a way to gain entry via a permanent arcane cloaking of sorts - an old cantrip of the Kirin ⟦E15⟧ with a few modifications of my own. With that said, the cloaking is costly; however, your dedication to the cause of the Dawn is unwavering! We will waive all cost associations.
rows.quest:9123:completion:0: You will feel a slight tingle, ⟦26⟧. That sensation means it's working. Once complete, you will be able to enter ⟦E14⟧ by stepping upon the rune portal in Plaguewood.
rows.quest:9124:obj:0: Huntsman Leopold at Light's ⟦E3⟧ Chapel in the ⟦E1⟧ wants 30 Crypt Fiend Parts.
rows.quest:9124:details:0: How would you like to earn yourself one of these shiny coins?
rows.quest:9124:details:1: B<Leopold holds up an insignia of the Crusade.>
rows.quest:9124:details:2: BI've got a little problem that you might be able to help me with, ⟦27⟧. You see, I make Cryptstalker armor for those daft enough to venture into ⟦E14⟧. While they supply me with the core material requirements for the armor, I always run out of the crypt fiend parts. Bring me back a bundle of parts and I'll pay you with an insignia - usable at the quartermaster.
rows.quest:9124:completion:0: Ah, that'll do nicely, ⟦28⟧. Remember, I'm always accepting more parts. For every bundle you bring me, I'll reward you with an insignia.
rows.quest:9126:obj:0: Rohan the Assassin at Light's ⟦E3⟧ Chapel in the ⟦E1⟧ wants 30 Bone Fragments.⟦29⟧
rows.quest:9126:details:0: Don Julio's Bonescythe armor pattern requires bone fragments - a lot of bone fragments. While those crazy enough to venture into ⟦E14⟧ provide me with enough of the core materials to make the armor, I'm always looking for more Scourge bone fragments.
rows.quest:9126:details:1: BSo what do you think? Interested in getting your hands dirty and destroying some Scourge at the same time? It's a win-win situation.
rows.quest:9126:completion:0: You work fast, ⟦30⟧. Fast like a fox... Say, have I ever told you about the time I was in a barber shop quartet?
rows.quest:9126:completion:1: BRemind me to tell you that story one of these days.
rows.quest:9128:obj:0: Archmage Angela Dosantos at Light's ⟦E3⟧ Chapel in the ⟦E1⟧ wants 30 Core of Elements.⟦31⟧
rows.quest:9128:details:0: Greetings, adventurer! Are you interested in some work? I pay those under my employ with insignias. These insignias can be used at the Quartermaster to purchase items of power.
rows.quest:9128:details:1: BAll I need you to do is bring me as many core of elements as you can carry. The more the better!
rows.quest:9128:details:2: BYou'll find them on elementals of varying shapes and sizes that exist across our world.
rows.quest:9128:completion:0: A job well done, ⟦32⟧! As promised, the INsignia is yours. Just remember, there's more WHERE that came from...
rows.quest:9131:obj:0: Korfax at Light's ⟦E3⟧ Chapel in the ⟦E1⟧ wants 30 Dark Iron Scraps.
rows.quest:9131:details:0: Have you ever seen Dreadnaught armor, ⟦33⟧? No, of course you haven't. You're still a ⟦34⟧ - a tyke. Let me tell you, it is glorious.
rows.quest:9131:details:1: BYou're probably asking yourself what any of this has to do with you, right? I'll tell you what, scrub; I need Dark Iron scraps and I'm willing to pay to get my hands on as many as possible.
rows.quest:9131:details:2: BI need the scraps to put together sets of Dreadnaught for our champions. Bring me scraps and get paid.
rows.quest:9131:completion:0: This will do, for now. If you get more, you know where to find me.
rows.quest:9136:obj:0: Rayne at Light's ⟦E3⟧ Chapel in the ⟦E1⟧ wants 30 Savage Fronds.
rows.quest:9136:details:0: I make a special type of armor for the brave heroes that enter ⟦E14⟧ known as Dreamwalker. They are able to provide me with most of the materials I require but I am always looking for those able to retrieve savage fronds from the flora of our world.
rows.quest:9136:details:1: BYou may think of this job as beneath you, but without the fronds, the armor could not be made.
rows.quest:9136:details:2: BI am also in a unique position to pay you with an insignia of your choice as both the Dawn and the Crusade supply me with funds.⟦35⟧
rows.quest:9136:completion:2: BPlease remember that I am always acceptINg fronds.
rows.quest:9141:obj:0: Dispatch Commander Metz at Light's ⟦E3⟧ Chapel in the ⟦E1⟧ wants an Argent Dawn Valor Token.⟦38⟧
rows.quest:9141:details:0: You want a writ? What? Do you expect me to hand you a highly sought after work order just for showing up? I think not, scrub. Crafters from around the world bid for jobs here at the front lines.
rows.quest:9141:details:1: BIf you want a work order, you'll have to show me that you're willing to bleed for the cause. Bring me a valor token and we'll talk.
rows.quest:9141:details:2: BAnd there's only one way to get your grubby little scrub mitts on those - get to killin'.
rows.quest:9141:completion:0: Alright, here's how it works: For every valor token that you turn in, I'll give you another writ. You complete the order on that writ and deliver the order to Packmaster Stonebruiser. Got it? Good. Now get out of here.
rows.quest:9378:obj:0: Archmage Angela Dosantos at Light's ⟦E3⟧ Chapel in the ⟦E1⟧ will grant you ⟦E13⟧ Cloaking at no cost. You must be Exalted with the Argent Dawn.
rows.quest:9378:details:0: In the thick of Plaguewood lies the entrance to the dread citadel of ⟦E14⟧. Previously, all attempts to enter had been stymied by the magical wards placed upon the rune portal. That is, until now.
rows.quest:9378:details:1: BWe have devised a way to gain entry via a permanent arcane cloaking of sorts - an old cantrip of the Kirin ⟦E15⟧ with a few modifications of my own. With that said, the cloaking is costly; however, your dedication to the cause of the Dawn is unwavering! We will waive all cost associations.
rows.quest:9664:obj:0: Capture Crown Guard Tower, Eastwall Tower, Northpass Tower and Plaguewood Tower in the ⟦E1⟧, then return to Emmisary Whitebeard at Light's ⟦E3⟧ Chapel.
rows.quest:9664:details:0: Welcome to the ⟦E16⟧, ⟦39⟧. As you know, the ⟦E7⟧ and their allies hold the lands to the west of here against our best efforts. The ⟦E12⟧ commanders have decided that here in the east, we will establish new fortifications to tighten the noose around our enemies.
rows.quest:9664:details:1: BTowers long abandoned since the days of Lordaeron are to be seized and rebuilt for this purpose. These lands are dangerous, and we could use your help.
rows.quest:9664:completion:0: Very good, ⟦40⟧. It will be important for us to hold these towers against future attacks, and for that we may need your assistance until reinforcements can be brought in to secure the area.
rows.quest:9665:obj:0: Capture Crown Guard Tower, Eastwall Tower, Northpass Tower and Plaguewood Tower in the ⟦E1⟧, then return to Emmisary Gormok at Light's ⟦E3⟧ Chapel.
rows.quest:9665:details:0: Agents of the ⟦E7⟧ uncovered an ⟦E12⟧ plot to establish new bases here in the ⟦E1⟧, at abandoned towers throughout the area.
rows.quest:9665:details:1: BIt is imperative that we not allow them to establish a significant presence on our eastern borders, and so we must stave off this ⟦E12⟧ incursion. Our current plans are to drive them out of any towers they may have already seized, and occupy those that we have under our control against further attacks.
rows.quest:9665:completion:0: This is good news, ⟦41⟧. It will be a constant struggle here in the ⟦E16⟧ until we have fully driven back the forces of the ⟦E12⟧.
rows.quest:9665:completion:1: BUntil that day, I hope that we will have your continued assistance.
